item.title: Graph Visualization with Hubble: Standalone Quick Start
item.description:
Hubble is the HugeGraph Web management and graph visualization interface. Use a single workspace to manage schema, import data, run queries, and switch smoothly between graph, table, and JSON results. This guide uses standalone RocksDB Server + Hubble, without requiring PD or Store.

For use with an HStore distributed cluster, read the foundational operations here first, then consult the distributed supplement. This guide aligns with the Toolchain and Server master branches (currently based on 1.8, unreleased). Docker latest is a moving tag; use released versions for production deployments.

item.title: HugeGraph-Loader Quick Start
item.description:
This guide aligns with the Toolchain master branch (currently based on 1.8, unreleased). Released packages and Docker latest may differ; check your version before using unreleased features.

Quick start: local file import

Walk through a minimal import workflow: import two people and one relationship, then verify the data in Hubble. First install Loader and start HugeGraph Server. The commands below run from the Loader directory, importing into the default graph hugegraph. For an authenticated Server, append --username and --password (or --token).

item.title: Tools Quick Start
item.description:
1 HugeGraph-Tools Overview

HugeGraph-Tools manages graphs and tasks and provides backup and restore commands. It also retains deployment commands for legacy Server/Studio versions.

Testing Guide: For running HugeGraph-Tools tests locally, please refer to HugeGraph Toolchain Local Testing Guide

2 Get HugeGraph-Tools

HugeGraph-Tools is included in the Toolchain distribution. You can download the distribution or build it from source.

  • Download the compiled tarball
  • Clone source code then compile and install

2.1 Download the compiled archive

The following example uses the released HugeGraph-Toolchain 1.7.0 package. Check the download page for releases.

item.title: HugeGraph-Spark-Connector Quick Start
item.description:
1 HugeGraph-Spark-Connector Overview

HugeGraph-Spark-Connector uses the Spark DataFrame API to write bulk data to HugeGraph. The current implementation provides vertex and edge writers.

Reading from HugeGraph is not implemented yet: the table only implements SupportsWrite, so spark.read.format(...) is not supported. The connector supports the CUSTOMIZE and PRIMARY_KEY vertex id strategies; the AUTOMATIC strategy is rejected.

2 Environment Requirements

  • Java 8+
  • Maven 3.6+
  • Spark 3.2.x (the module is built against Spark 3.2.2 with provided scope, so your Spark runtime must supply the Spark jars)
  • Scala 2.12 (built with Scala 2.12.11)

3 Building

3.1 Build without executing tests 

1git clone https://github.com/apache/hugegraph-toolchain.git
2cd hugegraph-toolchain
3mvn clean package -pl hugegraph-spark-connector -am -DskipTests -ntp

3.2 Build with default tests 

1mvn clean package -pl hugegraph-spark-connector -am -ntp

Both commands produce a fat jar at hugegraph-spark-connector/target/hugegraph-spark-connector-${revision}-jar-with-dependencies.jar (Spark itself is not bundled). Pass it to spark-submit --jars when you do not manage the dependency through Maven.
